TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd brings a risk-managed, government-ready delivery model for PITB’s ICMS District Case Management—grounded in mature quality and information security practices, and proven execution on large, complex technology programs. We are ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certified, with CMMI L3 also held at the company level, enabling disciplined requirements-to-release controls and secure SDLC governance aligned to public-sector expectations. [CO-PROFILE] Our footprint across Federal and Provincial Government engagements demonstrates our ability to operate in regulated environments and deliver production-grade systems and infrastructure. [CO-PROFILE]

Differentiators PITB can rely on:
1) Security-first implementation and operations: we have delivered ISO 27001-governed programs including Cloud Infrastructure (PKR 108M, Federal Govt, completed 2025) and Cybersecurity (PKR 178M, Provincial Govt, completed 2021), providing a strong basis for implementing RBAC, auditability, and data protection controls for citizen data. [CAP-012][CAP-049]
2) Scale and delivery certainty: we have executed multiple PKR 50M+ projects within the last five years, including Cloud Infrastructure (PKR 122M, Federal Govt, completed 2021) and LMS Development (PKR 102M, Provincial Govt, completed 2023). [CAP-048][CAP-046]
3) Change enablement for government users: our LMS deployments provide relevant experience for structured training and adoption across dispersed user groups. [CAP-046][CAP-022]
4) Local presence for sustained support: with offices in Lahore plus in-country support desk operations, we are positioned to meet on-site support and SLA-based O&M obligations. [CO-PROFILE]

Where PITB’s mandatory requirement specifies two CISSP (or equivalent) resources, our library does not yet evidence those named certifications; we will close this gap through pre-award hiring/augmentation and present certified CVs for approval. [CO-PROFILE]
